profile.headline: Senior AI Software Engineer at Vista Higher Learning
profile.summary:
Passionate software engineering leader with years of experience in software and web development—dedicated to creating impactful and industry-leading online learning tools that help individuals start, grow, and thrive in their careers. My work focuses on designing and architecting scalable systems, custom plugins, and micro services for leading Learning Management Systems, with a strong emphasis on B2B/B2C integrations and content delivery. I lead a team of talented engineers, driving the development of innovative educational platforms and services. I'm deeply involved in technical architecture, mentoring, and cross-functional collaboration to deliver high-quality, sustainable solutions that align with business goals. 
Highlights:
* Engineering Leadership: leading and mentoring high-performing software teams, fostering growth, collaboration, team culture and continuous improvement.
* Architectural Strategy: Define Architectures—shaping technical direction and collaborating with leaders across engineering and product.
* LMS & EdTech Expertise: Recognized SME in Moodle LMS. Skilled in developing custom plugins, enhancing functionality, and integrating third-party tools.
* Full-Stack Development: Deep experience with PHP, Java, J2EE, Python and Ruby—building reliable web applications and scalable backend systems.
* Cloud & DevOps: Advocate for cloud-native architectures, containerization (Kubernetes), CI/CD, and close collaboration with SRE/DevOps teams for performance and reliability.
* Cross-Functional Collaboration: Effectively bridge the gap between engineering, business analysts, and product managers to deliver sustainable, high-quality solutions aligned with business goals.
* Innovation & R&D: Encourage technology exploration and innovation through research, prototyping, and adoption of emerging trends to enhance development and optimize performance. Promote research and experimentation with new technologies.
* Strong Interpersonal Skills: Known for clear communication, decisive problem-solving, and the ability to navigate complexity with confidence. 

Always exploring new ways to elevate learning experiences through technology. Let’s connect if you’re passionate about EdTech, software architecture, or building tools that make a real-world impact.
